description: Figure 4 presents the experimental results comparing MATTER with a tokenizer trained without material knowledge during tokenization training. The number of tokens varied from 0.5x to 1.5x of the original size. The results show that MATTER consistently outperforms the tokenizer trained without material knowledge.
